_comment: Accepted pinned revision carried by the Grok Bot bridge (two-commit content/pin model, see scripts/render-skills.py). stage "content": the content commit R; no commit/release/label; the bridge renders an unpinned placeholder line and must not be saved. stage "pinned": the pin commit P that follows R; commit = R (40-hex) plus exactly one of release (a vX.Y.Z tag at R) or label (honest pre-release text, 3-80 plain characters). render-skills.py --write then changes exactly one line of the bridge; --check verifies the pin against this Git checkout and --require-pinned is the gate for P.
